title: Virtual Compute: category-specific metering rules
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “snapshot bills GB-month at snapshot storage rate;” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under the applicable tax treatment.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The primary instance package has virtual core count virtual cores, memory in GiB memory and included boot storage in GB included boot storage. Standard Linux primary usage uses the ordinary primary price. For dedicated configuration multiply the undiscounted primary rate by dedicated tenancy multiplier before the normal discount priority. For spot configuration use spot discount fraction instead of every commitment, promotion and portfolio discount; spot is mutually exclusive with a reservation and approved negotiated pricing. Meter code boot storage bills only provisioned GB-month above included boot storage in GB at boot disk rate. windows license bills actual vCPU-hours at windows license rate and linux license at linux license rate, independently of compute discounts. image export bills processed GB at image export rate. internet egress bills actual monthly GB beyond included monthly internet transfer in GB at egress rate. Resource count, measured duration and the selected tier virtual core count determine licensed vCPU-hours; changing capacity splits intervals. A zero-rate license or included transfer creates no charge. The separate Network contract never rebills transfer already marked as compute-managed on its source resource export. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included primary quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for category-specific metering rules?**

The primary instance package has virtual core count virtual cores, memory in GiB memory and included boot storage in GB included boot storage.
